assets.title: Neural 3D Video (N3DV) coffee_martini
assets.description: Synchronized multi-view MP4 videos and LLFF camera poses (poses_bounds.npy) for one N3DV scene, upstream release v1.0.
assets.citation: T. Li, M. Slavcheva, M. Zollhoefer, S. Green, C. Lassner, C. Kim, T. Schmidt, S. Lovegrove, M. Goesele, R. Newcombe, and Z. Lv, "Neural 3D Video Synthesis from Multi-view Video," in Proc. IEEE/CVF Conf. Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2022.

files.note: Whole-archive digest unpublished; every part is pinned.
